title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.


Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!


Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, youâll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.


About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

  • Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

  • A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms â you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

Compensation

title: Backend Software Engineer (m/f/d), Rust – AI-first E-commerce Tech
description:
Since 2018, we’ve become one of Google’s largest CSS Premium Partners, powering Shopping ads for 1,000+ customers across 20,000+ Merchant Centres in Europe.

Fully self-funded, profitable and still expanding, we’re a strong and supportive team with a stable foundation. Now we’re looking for a new colleague who wants to be part of it for the long run: an engineer who gets a goal rather than a ticket, builds with AI as a natural part of the job, and takes ownership from idea to production.

Why adstrong

  • 100% remote: work from anywhere in the EU, with flexible hours and no weekend or night work.

  • No process chaos: documentation and procedures are well-structured and digital.

  • No politics: we encourage proactive decisions and make ours within 24 hours.

  • Stable and growing: a fully self-funded, fast-growing company with no external investors.

  • Small, skilled team: a hands-on tech team of around 6 people.

  • Great working culture: supportive colleagues who help each other and share knowledge openly.

  • AI-first: coding agents are how we build, and your judgement is what matters.

  • Attractive compensation: plus all the equipment you need.

  • Missing anything? Mention it in your application, and we’ll see if we can make it happen.

What you will do

  • Build AI-first: plan with AI, drive coding agents and review their output with a critical eye.

  • Get a goal, not a ticket: work directly with colleagues on the business side to gather requirements, align on the solution and build it into working software.

  • Make sound architecture and data-model decisions, keeping our systems fast and reliable as we scale.

  • Take ownership of existing applications and build new solutions for our affiliate business.

  • Design and develop event-driven backend systems that handle large volumes of product and campaign data, mostly in Rust and partly in Python.

  • Own your topics end to end and keep the team and stakeholders in the loop along the way.

What you bring

  • Experience contributing to a strong engineering culture, e.g. through code reviews, knowledge sharing, or improving team tools and ways of working.

  • Daily hands-on work with coding agents: you plan with AI, delegate the implementation and know how to review what comes back, including more complex workflows like one model writing code while another reviews it.

  • Strong architectural awareness: you know which components and infrastructure to use for which problem, and how to structure what you build.

  • Rust experience, or curiosity about it and readiness to make it your main language, as most of our backend is written in it. C or C++ experience is a strong alternative.

  • Experience solving problems close to ours, ideally in e-commerce, affiliate marketing, Google Shopping, Google Ads or other data-heavy web platforms. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge.

  • Experience with event-driven systems (e.g. Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS or similar)

  • A solid grasp of the full engineering process: requirements, design, trade-offs, testing and maintainability

  • Mid- or senior-level experience. We care more about how you think and work than about years on paper. Our business team will help you build the domain knowledge.

  • A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

  • Business-fluent English (C1).

Our stack: Rust and some Python on the backend, TypeScript / Next.js on the frontend (handled by our frontend engineers, so it’s optional for you), plus AWS, SQL databases, Elasticsearch and GitLab. Familiarity with any of these is an advantage, but it’s not a checklist you need to match.

How you work

  • You communicate clearly and proactively. You’re comfortable talking to business colleagues, ask the right questions early, share progress without being asked and explain technical trade-offs in plain language.

  • You value good engineering culture. We improve as a team, so honest feedback matters to us, and so do your ideas for improving our team culture, tools and the way we work in IT.

  • You organize yourself. Give you a goal, and you’ll plan the work, set priorities and follow through, without needing a detailed ticket for every step.

  • You’re genuinely curious. You enjoy digging into new topics, including the business side, and you keep learning as tools and AI evolve.

  • You take ownership. You care about the outcome, not just the code, and you drive your topics forward instead of waiting for direction.

If you match most of these points and want to help shape the technology behind one of Europe’s leading CSS providers, we’d love to hear from you. There’s no classic coding test in our process. Instead, we’ll talk through a realistic goal together and see how you approach it with AI.

Apply now if you want stability without standing still: a place to learn, grow and stay.

But that’s just the beginning:

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.


Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

title: Enterprise Sales Leader (UK-based)
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build one of n8n’s most predictable Enterprise sales teams. You’ll develop high-performing Enterprise AEs, instill forecast and pipeline discipline, and create a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

To make that happen, you’ll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win:

DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE TEAM

  • Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews, raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance.

  • Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes your numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics.

  • Create a repeatable operating model with clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms, so execution doesn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal.

  • Hire, onboard, and scale the team quickly, establishing career paths and succession plans as we grow.

SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR YOUR TERRITORY

  • Prioritize and run your Enterprise territory with focus, balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong.

  • Set the strategy for the team’s most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen.

  • Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical and business wins.

BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION

  • Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution.

  • Orchestrate executive engagement across your accounts, aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals.

  • Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy.

PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: You have 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals.

  • 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: You have deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record of coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection.

  • 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: You’ve run a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive.

  • 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals.

  • 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes.

  • 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback.

  • 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum.

  • 🇬🇧 UK location: You’re based in the UK and happy being on-site with customers once per week on average

  • 🇬🇧 English: You’re a native or bilingual speaker of English.

  • 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: You have experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions.

  • 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion.

Nice-to-haves

  • Additional languages: You're fluent in French or Spanish.

  • 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: You’ve worked in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories.

  • 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving, and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down.

  • 📊 Operational excellence: You have strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution.

Why join us?
You’ll take a team of Enterprise AEs and turn it into a repeatable engine, in one of the fastest-growing open-source companies in Europe. The playbooks you build and the people you hire will shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest technical organizations. You’ll work directly with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product, so your voice carries well beyond your own team. n8n is a remote-first company with a passionate community of builders, a culture of autonomy and experimentation, and a very high bar for talent. If you want to build something that lasts while the company scales, apply now and help us make n8n the default way enterprises automate.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

title: Engineering Manager (w/m/d) Robotics Tooling
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in einem Team, das das gesamte Tooling-Ökosystem verantwortet, mit dem unsere Jungheinrich Robotics Lösungen über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg implementiert, betrieben, unterstützt und kontinuierlich verbessert werden. Von der Inbetriebnahme eines Fahrzeugs vor Ort bis hin zur Ferndiagnose von Problemen einer gesamten Flotte stellst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Robotiksysteme über alle Robotikprodukte und zukünftigen Fahrzeuggenerationen hinweg effizient und skalierbar ausgeliefert, betrieben und unterstützt werden können.

Du arbeitest dabei in drei zentralen Bereichen:

  • Du entwickelst unser Onsite Tooling weiter und ermöglichst damit eine effiziente Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme und Durchführung von Serviceaktivitäten über unser HMI und unseren Environment Editor.
  • Du entwickelst unser Remote Tooling als Teil unserer Robotics Cloud weiter und ermöglichst damit Diagnose, Flottenmanagement, Monitoring und Support aus der Ferne.
  • Du gestaltest unsere Remote-Access-Lösungen und stellst einen sicheren und skalierbaren Zugriff auf unsere Robotiksysteme sicher, wann immer dieser erforderlich ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product Manager für Robotics Tooling zusammen. Während der Product Manager den Fokus stärker auf das Was und Warum legt, ergänzt du diese Perspektive um das Wie und Wann.

  • Du verantwortest die technische Ausrichtung unseres Toolings, das eine schnelle Implementierung, effiziente Serviceprozesse, den Flottenbetrieb, Ferndiagnosen und eine hohe Systemverfügbarkeit ermöglicht
  • Du gestaltest ein skalierbares Tooling-Ökosystem, das über verschiedene Roboterfamilien, Kundeninstallationen und Supportorganisationen hinweg eingesetzt werden kann
  • Du führst und entwickelst ein Team aus internen und externen Software Engineers und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem sich Mitarbeitende weiterentwickeln, erfolgreich arbeiten und wirkungsvolle Lösungen liefern können
  • Du definierst, steuerst und verfolgst gemeinsam mit dem Product Manager die vereinbarte Roadmap und stellst deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicher
  • Du baust starke Partnerschaften mit Product Management, Vehicle Engineering, Service, Operations und IT auf, um ein integriertes Tooling-Ökosystem zu realisieren
  • Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die User Experience für Inbetriebnahme- und Servicetechniker:innen, Supportteams und unsere Kunden
  • Du gestaltest die Strategie und Umsetzung sicherer Remote-Access-Lösungen und bringst dabei betriebliche Effizienz, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Kundenbedürfnisse in Einklang
  • Du förderst die Weiterentwicklung und Leistungsfähigkeit deines Teams durch Engagement, Coaching, individuelle Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
  • Du treibst Engineering Excellence durch agile Arbeitsweisen, qualitativ hochwertige Softwareentwicklung und moderne Engineering-Standards voran

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Führung von Software-Engineering-Teams in agilen Produktentwicklungsumgebungen mit.
  • Du verfügst über einen starken Software-Engineering-Hintergrund und praktische technische Erfahrung.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Coaching von Engineers mit und unterstützt sie aktiv in ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in den Bereichen Robotik, Automatisierung, Embedded Systems oder vergleichbaren technischen Bereichen mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Frontend-Anwendungen und nutzerorientierter Software.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und wirkungsvoll und bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf gemeinsame Ziele zusammen.
  • Du begeisterst dich dafür, reale Herausforderungen mithilfe von Technologie zu lösen.
  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort, weshalb du idealerweise in München oder der näheren Umgebung wohnst.
  • Das ist ein Plus:
    • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) mit.
    • Du kennst die Abläufe rund um die Implementierung, den Service oder den Betrieb von Robotern.
    • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Monitoring-, Observability- oder Remote-Diagnostics-Lösungen mit.
    • Du kennst dich mit Networking, Infrastruktur, Security oder Remote-Access-Konzepten aus.
    • Du bringst Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden oder operativen Teams im Feld mit.

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Menschen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativenund vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilitä t: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, Wellpass‑,Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahre hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Benefits.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

title: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer
description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

  • We prioritize customer needs first

  • We work in small, project-based teams

  • We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

  • We own the full lifecycle of our projects

  • We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

  • We balance quality and velocity

  • We have a shared responsibility for our production code

  • We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

 

Your mission

 

You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.

You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.

Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.

If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

 

Part of your day-to-day

 

  • Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

  • Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

  • Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

  • Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models.

  • Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship.

  • Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs)

 

What we’re looking for

 

Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes:

  • Solid machine learning/data science background: you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings, especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them.

  • Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements.

  • Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure.

  • Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship.

  • Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship.

  • Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development.

  • Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization

  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment.

 

Location

This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe, in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3).

 

Hiring Process

  • Stage 1. Talent Partner (30-45 min)

  • Stage 2. Take-home challenge (flexible) + Technical Discussion with the team (1h)

  • Stage 3. Technical design exercise and situational questions in session w/ two ML Engineers (1h)

  • Stage 4. Behavioral interview w/ Engineering leadership (1h)

  • Offer

  • Identity Verification

What we offer

💰 Generous compensation + stock options - aligned with our internal framework, market data, and individual skills.

🏢 Distributed work: Work from anywhere - fully remote, in our hubs, or a mix.

💻 Company-issued laptop, remote setup stipend, and co-working budget

📍 Flexible schedules and location

☀️ Ample paid time off, in addition to local public holidays

🍼 Enhanced parental leave

🧘‍♀️ Health & retirement benefits

📖 Annual learning & development budget

🌴 Annual workaways and regular virtual & in-person socials

🌍 Opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that shape the future of work

Note: Some benefits may vary depending on location and role

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You are a T-shaped product engineer with a spike in backend engineering. You will work closely with the product and engineering team to build user-facing features, ship at pace, and support the existing infrastructure as we scale. You do not need to be a DevOps expert, but familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes is valuable.

You take initiative, adapt quickly, and communicate clearly. The team is small and fast-moving, so you’ll be expected to make decisions and ship code autonomously. You will help the company grow from $3M to $30M ARR, owning projects end-to-end—from ideation to deployment—while helping shape how we build products and infrastructure at Kernel.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Designing and developing product features that directly impact user workflows

  • Collaborating with design, product, and other engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences

  • Writing and maintaining clean, reliable, and scalable code across the stack

  • Helping ensure performance and reliability for large-scale data operations

  • Automating workflows to improve developer velocity and reduce manual work

  • Supporting integrations with CRMs and third-party APIs

  • Participating in roadmap discussions and contributing technical insights

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of software or product engineering experience

  • Strong experience building and scaling production systems

  • Comfort with backend engineering (NodeJS, Postgres, TypeScript)

  • Strong understanding of LLM application development patterns (RAG, prompt engineering, consistency testing) - either through production experience or demonstrated personal projects. If you're new to LLMs but have shipped complex production systems in other domains and are comfortable rapidly learning new technologies, we'd still love to hear from you.

  • Ability to operate autonomously in a small, high-velocity team

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

  • Some experience with Kubernetes or distributed systems

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience working on AI-driven or data-heavy products

  • Frontend experience (NextJS, React, TypeScript)

  • Understanding of CRM data models or workflow automation

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Need lots of structure or long-term roadmaps

  • Prefer perfect specs before building

  • Focus narrowly on backend or frontend only

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Prefer fully remote work (this role requires at least 3 days a week in the office)

  • Don’t enjoy the pace of early-stage startups

  • Want to manage a team rather than build

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £110,000 – £150,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

🛠️ Tech Stack

  • Back-end (AWS): NodeJS, TypeScript, Postgres

  • Front-end: NextJS, TypeScript, Tailwind

  • Workflow automation: n8n

🎫 Visas & Relocation

We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates and provide relocation support for those moving to London.

Interview Process

Stage 1: Introductory Call (40 minutes)

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Call (40 minutes)

Stage 3: Take-Home Task (≤ 2 hours)

Stage 4: Technical Interview (90 minutes)

Final Stage: Founders Interview - a conversation with Anders (CEO) and Marcus (CTO) focused on values alignment and long-term vision.

Following Mutual Fit: Reference checks and offer stage.

description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Nice-to-haves

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • TDD

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

  • Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review

To Apply

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

title: RevOps Lead
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 10x YoY.

The Role

We’re looking for a RevOps Lead to own the systems, data and operating rhythms behind Kernel’s revenue engine. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, and Finance to build and own GTM systems that take us to $100m+ ARR.

This is a builder role and our first dedicated RevOps hire. You’ll improve the foundations already in place while designing what Kernel’s RevOps model should become as we scale. You’ll also be Kernel’s own internal customer, deploying Kernel on our CRM to improve our data, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what we learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering.

You’ll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations, and partner closely with our Finance & Operations team and GTM leadership.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Run the revenue operating rhythm: own pipeline management, forecasting, funnel reporting, quota planning, GTM incentive compensation and the systems behind renewals and expansion - giving leadership a clear view of performance, risk and what needs attention

  • Make the GTM team more productive: simplify processes, automate repetitive work using AI agents and improve handoffs so Sales, Marketing and Account Management can spend more time with customers and less time on admin

  • Make our outbound motion better: improve targeting, account prioritization, routing, sequencing and performance measurement so the team consistently focuses on the right companies at the right time

  • Own the GTM tooling and tech stack: make Salesforce the source of truth, own the systems around it and ensure our sales engagement, enrichment, and automation tools work together reliably

  • Set the rules of engagement: own account assignment and routing, settle ownership disputes, and make sure every meeting booked and held is captured and credited to the right person

  • Be Kernel’s own internal customer: deploy Kernel on Kernel’s CRM, use it to improve our GTM data and turn what we learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a high-growth Series A-D SaaS company. You have owned meaningful parts of the revenue engine end to end, ideally as the first or one of the first RevOps operators

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: you understand objects, record types, fields, formulas, flows, validation rules, permissions, reports and data migration. You can reason about architecture and debug production behaviour

  • Commercial judgement: you understand how meetings become pipeline, how pipeline is qualified and forecast, and how won revenue flows into implementation, expansion, renewal and retention

  • Technical building ability: you have built and deployed AI or agent-assisted workflows into real operating processes, are comfortable with connecting different systems together, and can debug how systems behave

  • Strong analytical skills: you can build funnel, capacity and revenue models, work confidently in spreadsheets, and reconcile numbers across systems

  • Clear, low-ego communication: you can turn a messy request into a crisp decision, explain trade-offs to non-technical teams, push back constructively and drive adoption through influence rather than authority

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience supporting an enterprise sales motion with multi-stakeholder deals and MEDDPICC.

  • Experience with renewals, expansion, compensation, quota setting or planning

  • Familiarity with Gong, Slack workflows, sales engagement platforms and modern data or enrichment tooling

  • Experience building operational controls around LLM- or agent-powered workflows

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Prefer strategy and recommendations over configuring systems, cleaning data, investigating edge cases and debugging workflows yourself

  • Need outlined requirements or stable priorities before you can make progress

  • See RevOps primarily as CRM administration or ticket fulfilment rather than a revenue-generating operating function

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Are not comfortable taking broad ownership of a function

  • Prefer a predictable, low-intensity environment

  • Want to protect a 9-to-6 or a mostly remote setup - we are in the office together 4–5 days a week and the pace is high

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £70,000–£90,000 + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 monthly office dinner allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

❤️ Team

Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations

Amin Shafi, BizOps Associate

Dave Bentham, Head of Sales

🎫 Visas & Relocation

Not offered for this role.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening - Intro call

  • Stage 2: Technical - In-person case interview

  • Stage 3: Coffee chat - In-person discussion with our GTM team

  • Final Stage: Values - Interview with founders for culture and values alignment

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

title: 3D Chiplet Engineer
description:
About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality.

Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute.

About the role: 

We are looking for a 3D Integration / Chiplet Expert to define and implement 2.5D/3D advanced packaging solutions for our Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM) technology. You will collaborate across teams to define optimal interconnect strategies and die stacking approaches to enable high-bandwidth, low-power operation. This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Integration Architecture & Process Definition:
    Develop and define architectures for 2.5D/3D stacking of VIM chiplets with compute chiplets.
    Collaborate with design and technology teams to develop interconnect solutions that ensure high bandwidth and low latency.
    Define clearly the impact of the chiplet physical design chiplets (through-silicon vias, micro-bumps, hybrid bonds, redistribution layers, and chiplet interfaces, …)
    define fabrication flows and design rules with foundries, packaging partners, and internal physical design teams

  • Performance Analysis & Simulation:
    Conduct early multi-physics simulations (thermal, electrical, mechanical) to analyze and optimize the performance and reliability of integrated systems.
    drive external partners for final package design

  • Collaboration & Communication:
    Partner closely with design, process engineering, metrology, and system architecture teams.
    Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration.

  • Technical Leadership:Provide
    technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary  teams.

About the team: 

This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system  and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success.



About who you are:

  • You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems.

  • You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs)   

  • You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …)    

  • You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs.

  • Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly.

  • You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams.

  • You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand.

  • Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation.

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities.


Why Join Us:

  • You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation.

  • Vertical Compute is not only a state-of-the art but also a human adventure. We believe you must have a lot of fun developing the best of you. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders.

  • You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics.

  • You can count on a motivating total rewards package.

  • Flexible ways of working.

Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success!

title: Software Engineer - Map & Route
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Map & Route Team

Our Map & Route team sits within Wayve’s Automotive Platforms division in Vehicle Software Engineering, and builds the geospatial foundations behind our AI driver. Working with global-scale data, the team turns road-network and navigation data into reliable products used across Wayve, building geospatial services and data products to support company operations. We work with our model development, experimentation, and evaluation platforms to build an AI driver that uses maps and navigation data like an expert human driver by using map information to enhance training and evaluation of performance. We are a full-stack team owning mapping end to end, getting to touch work that is infrastructure, data engineering, data science, backend and frontend.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Write full-stack services in Python and Typescript, creating novel geospatial services to solve challenging and unique problems we face in building our AI driving products.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to understand requirements and build solutions with global geospatial data.

  • Design and build data pipelines with PySpark and Databricks to enrich fleet data with mapping and road-network information at global scale.

  • Build applications and datasets that support route planning and the preparation of map data for training and simulation.

  • Integrate with navigation and mapping APIs from providers such as Mapbox, TomTom and Google Maps.

  • Maintain, support and improve the services the team already runs.

  • Deploy and operate your services on Azure and Kubernetes, owning them end to end.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Global-scale geospatial enrichment pipelines that tell us where we’ve driven and what the road network looks like.

  • Route-planning applications and datasets that help our teams decide where to drive next.

  • Map data preparation for model training and simulation.

  • New services you’ll take from idea to production and lead end to end.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You are a strong, hands-on Python engineer who can deliver high-quality production code at pace.

  • You are comfortable with an AI-assisted or AI engineering workflow (ideation, planning, implementation and review).

  • You have built and operated large-scale data pipelines using Spark or PySpark.

  • You are comfortable writing SQL to query and analyse large datasets.

  • You have working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and container orchestration, ideally Azure and Kubernetes, and are happy to own deployment, monitoring, and observability of your services.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of new services and seeing them through end to end.

  • Experience with geospatial data processing, road-network data or routing engines (e.g. OpenStreetMap, TomTom, HERE or Overture data, PostGIS, navigation APIs) would be a strong advantage.

  • Experience with Bazel or monorepo build systems is desirable but not mandatory.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Flyte or Airflow would be a bonus.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews: Python Programming (60 mins) and Hiring Manager interview (45 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: Systems Design (60 mins) and Domain interview (60 mins)

  • Final interview: Mission and Values Alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

 

About the role

Software Engineers at Axle build the core infrastructure for connecting to distributed energy devices, orchestrating them, and allowing them to participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist Software Engineering role, encompassing product-engineering, devops, and data engineering. We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem-space as they can: you’ll spend time talking to clients, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

Software engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of the domain & the business, so you have enough context to execute independently at speed

  • Focusing on outcomes, not process, and taking ownership for the end product you ship into the world

  • Managing your own time and those of others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, delivering 80% of the value in 20% of the time

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation: £75K – £200K

  • • Total Compensation (salary + equity) £75K – £200K
