title: Senior Product Manager, Panel (Remote, EU/UK)
description:
About Maze

Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development.

In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in.

We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision.

Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves.

That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey—and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more.

Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values.

Location: Remote, preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal.

Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales.

About the Role

Maze customers need to reach the right participants and trust the quality of the people taking part in their studies. Recruitment is a critical part of research.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the recruitment and panel experience at Maze. You’ll help shape how customers recruit and manage participants across unmoderated, moderated, AI-moderated and future research experiences.

This is a highly cross-functional product area that sits at the intersection of product, operations and our panel partner ecosystem. You’ll work in a trio with Engineering and Design while partnering closely with our Panel Operations team, GTM, Customer Success, Research Partners and other product teams.

You’ll own the customer and participant experiences as well as the systems behind them, helping Maze deliver a recruitment experience that is high-quality, reliable and able to scale with increasingly complex customer needs.

You’ll work on:

  • Own and evolve the roadmap for recruitment and participant management across Maze.

  • Improve participant quality by building stronger feedback loops, quality signals, filtering and experiences that reduce confusion for participants.

  • Make it easier for customers to recruit the audiences they need across different study types, including more complex enterprise use cases.

  • Use data and customer insights to understand panel performance and identify gaps in participant supply, quality and fulfillment.

  • Partner with Panel Operations to continuously improve the tools, workflows and handoffs used to fulfill recruitment requests.

  • Help evaluate and onboard new panel partners and identify where deeper integrations can improve quality, coverage or efficiency.

  • Develop smarter ways to route studies to the right participant supply based on customer and study needs.

  • Stay close to the operational side of recruitment so product decisions are grounded in how participant fulfillment actually happens.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success and Research Partners to understand customer needs, recruitment feasibility and opportunities to improve the recruitment experience.

  • Define and measure success across participant quality, fulfillment and the overall recruitment experience.

You should apply if:

  • You have experience as a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager owning meaningful product areas from discovery through execution.

  • You’re highly autonomous and comfortable taking a problem, creating structure around it and driving it forward without waiting for perfect direction.

  • You’re a clear, structured communicator who can bring others along in how you think about a problem, recommendation or decision.

  • You’re comfortable working on products that span software, operations and external partners rather than living entirely within a single product surface.

  • You’re comfortable getting close to operational workflows and using what you learn to make better product decisions.

  • You have strong product judgment and can make thoughtful tradeoffs when there isn’t a perfect answer.

  • You’re experienced partnering closely with Engineering and Design to take products from discovery through delivery and iteration.

  • You think in systems and look for scalable product solutions rather than one-off workarounds.

  • You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, business needs, operational realities and technical constraints.

  • You thrive in an environment where you can move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information and continuously learn from customers and internal teams.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Strong data fluency and experience using data to understand problems, prioritize opportunities and measure product outcomes.

  • Experience building products with a meaningful operational component.

  • Marketplace or supply-and-demand product experience.

  • Experience in operations, business development or other roles that required you to work across product and business problems.

  • Experience managing stakeholders across multiple teams or functions.

  • Experience working with external partners, vendors or integrations that are critical to the customer experience.

  • Experience with user research or research participant recruitment.

Inclusivity and Pay

At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. 

Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package.

Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.

Why Maze is unique

  • Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze.

  • Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge.

  • Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions

Benefits

  • Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid

    • For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information

  • Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources

  • Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid

  • Flexible time off

  • Meaningful equity

  • Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze

  • New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze

  • Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents

  • $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage

    • If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever!

  • $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space

  • Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours

  • Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more

  • Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year

  • SWAG, we have some really cool swag

  • Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here. 

Outreach Notice

We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application, as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function, sales, customer support, HR, finance, is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value, with no data ever leaving your environment.

Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and the partners we work with are what make it scale. As our Lead of Partnerships & Operations, you take ownership of those partnerships, make them perform, and run the operations behind them: contracts, launches, numbers, processes.

You work directly with the founders. Your scope starts with partnerships and operations, and it grows with what you show you can carry.

Strategic partnerships

  • Identify, negotiate and close the partnerships that change our trajectory: technology platforms, payment and distribution partners, AI players

  • Own the terms: revenue share, minimum guarantees, integration scope, timelines

  • Run each partnership after signature: launch plan, regular business reviews, next step always dated

  • Follow each partner's numbers closely, know why they moved before anyone asks, and decide with the team what to scale and what to stop

Operations

  • Run partner and advertiser launches end to end with Product and Tech: requirements, go-live, follow-up

  • Own our contracts and the legal topics around them, with our counsel

  • Build the dashboards and processes that make all this repeatable, with AI and automation wherever they save time

  • Bring what partners and advertisers tell you back into the product roadmap

Topics with no owner yet

  • Take them and get them done: a contract to close, a business case to model, a process to set up, a problem nobody has diagnosed

Example projects for your first months

  • A key partner's revenue drops overnight. Find the cause, and ship the fix with Tech

  • Model the revenue of a new partnership before we commit to a minimum guarantee, then track it against reality

  • Launch a new partner in a few weeks, with one plan shared by Business, Product and Tech

Profile

Must-have

  • 4 to 8 years in partnerships, business development, BizOps or strategy & operations, ideally in adtech, media, payments or a tech startup

  • You have negotiated and closed partnerships yourself, and you can tell us what they brought in

  • Strong with numbers: you build your own models and dashboards, and you notice when a figure looks wrong

  • Comfortable with technical topics: you can discuss an integration with an engineer or a partner's tech team without a translator

  • You unblock and you execute: when something stalls, you find out why and get it moving again

  • Reliable: what you commit to gets done

  • Fluent French and excellent English, written and spoken

A plus

  • Adtech or advertising experience

  • Startup or scale-up experience, or you have founded something

  • A first experience in consulting or banking, followed by an operating role

  • SQL

  • AI-forward: you use AI tools in your daily workflow and have already automated part of it

What we offer

  • Competitive salary + equity (BSPCE)

  • Real ownership from day one, and a scope that grows with you

  • A product that works, clients that renew, a demanding team

  • Meal vouchers with Swile, Alan health insurance, 7 weeks of vacation (RTT included), 50% transportation coverage

  • Paris 11e, on-site with up to 1 day remote per week

title: Account Executive
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in France.

As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market.


Accountabilities

  • Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies.

  • Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts.

  • Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities.

  • Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions.

  • Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption.

  • Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed.

  • Apply structured qualification methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to assess deal quality, understand decision-making processes, identify risks, and convert successful pilots into long-term production commitments.

  • Develop commercial proposals tailored to customer requirements, including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, dedicated deployments, and bring-your-own-cloud arrangements.

  • Identify opportunities for account expansion by working closely with field engineers and existing customers to understand evolving infrastructure needs and increase adoption.

  • Represent the business at industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and regional meetups, building relationships and converting networking opportunities into qualified pipeline.

  • Collaborate with go-to-market engineers to develop creative prospecting campaigns, improve sales automation, and refine outreach strategies based on market feedback and campaign performance.

  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the sales playbook, sharing insights on customer needs, competitive positioning, objections, and emerging market trends with the founding team and product organization.

  • Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, manage pipeline reporting, and provide reliable forecasts to support business planning and sales execution.

  • Support opportunities across the United States when needed, coordinating with the wider team and accommodating regular calls during European evening hours.

  • Help shape the future sales organization by establishing repeatable processes, sharing best practices, and contributing to the onboarding and development of future sales hires.

    • Requirements:

    • At least 4 years of experience in quota-carrying sales or closing roles, selling technical products to engineering-oriented buyers.

    • Proven experience selling technical solutions, ideally within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, developer tooling, virtualization, serverless computing, or related technology markets.

    • Demonstrated ability to build a sales pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account research, networking, and targeted engagement strategies.

    • Strong understanding of effective outbound sales practices, with the ability to develop compelling messaging, prioritize accounts, and guide others in improving prospecting performance.

    • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concept programs, and extended decision-making processes.

    • Ability to engage confidently with technical and economic buyers, including CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security stakeholders, procurement teams, and legal departments.

    • Sufficient technical knowledge to discuss virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies credibly with engineering teams, combined with the curiosity and motivation to deepen your expertise.

    • Experience converting pilots, proofs of concept, or technical evaluations into signed commercial agreements.

    • Familiarity with usage-based pricing, consumption-based business models, minimum commitments, or other flexible commercial structures.

    • Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to make customers feel comfortable while maintaining a rigorous, analytical approach to sales.

    • Excellent spoken and written English, with additional languages considered an advantage.

    • A high degree of ownership, initiative, adaptability, and learning agility, with the ability to identify problems, take action independently, and continuously improve how work gets done.

    • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to pipeline management, deal qualification, forecasting, and sales performance.

    • Willingness to attend industry events, travel regularly to customers across Europe, and occasionally travel to the United States.

    • Availability to work remotely from a European location within approximately two hours of Central European Time (CET), with flexibility to accommodate regular calls during US business hours.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience using AI tools to research accounts, personalize outreach, generate pipeline, automate sales workflows, and improve deal execution.

      • Familiarity with HubSpot or comparable CRM and sales pipeline management platforms.

      • A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical discipline.

      • Previous experience selling compute infrastructure, serverless platforms, sandboxing technologies, databases, Kubernetes tooling, or related developer infrastructure products.

      • Knowledge of the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure and developer platforms, including solutions such as Modal, E2B, Daytona, Fly.io, Northflank, Vercel, and Firecracker-based platforms.

      • An established network among European platform engineering teams, cloud providers, systems integrators, or infrastructure decision-makers.

      • Experience working with channel partners, resellers, cloud providers, or systems integrators to develop and close opportunities.

      • Previous experience as an early sales hire at a startup, with an appreciation for the ownership, pace, and adaptability required to build a sales function from an early stage.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive base salary with uncapped commission, providing significant earning potential tied to sales performance.

        • Meaningful equity participation, allowing you to share in the long-term growth of the business.

        • Fully remote working environment within Europe, with a preferred time zone of CET ±2 hours.

        • Direct access to the founding team, including hands-on coaching, technical support during sales conversations, and guidance on complex deals.

        • Opportunity to join an early-stage sales team and help shape the commercial strategy, sales playbook, and future structure of the organization.

        • The chance to sell an established technology already used in production by enterprise customers, with additional opportunities progressing through the pipeline.

        • Exposure to fast-growing markets spanning AI infrastructure, cloud computing, serverless workloads, secure sandboxing, and developer platforms.

        • Close collaboration with technical experts and go-to-market engineers, providing opportunities to deepen your technical knowledge and improve sales effectiveness.

        • Regular opportunities to attend leading industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and customer meetings across Europe, with occasional travel to the United States.

        • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment that rewards initiative, experimentation, continuous learning, and measurable impact.

        • The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the company's growth during a pivotal stage of its development.

title: Senior Brand Designer
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🐼 Who we are

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M users , and have reached 770M+ in ARR.

Our team of 700+ people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.

🤘 How we do it ?

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

  • Mission is the Boss: long-term thinking, mission above all else

  • Member & customer-led: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

  • Champions of excellence: extremely high standards and talent density

  • Distributed ownership: everyone owns their decisions and results

  • Radically transparent: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

  • Optimistic alchemy: optimists who collaborate with genuine care

  • Empathetic challengers: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow

  • Bold contrarians: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

  • Disciplined execution: decisive action with compounding focus

  • Fight for simplicity: high-impact processes, smart frugality


⭐️ Senior Brand Designer at Alan 

Our Brand at Alan is precious to us, and is evolving as we grow!

As part of the Design team, the Brand designer plays a large role in cementing our brand, creates visually compelling assets to support our messaging, and uses their experience to grow a strong brand design practice.

Your missions will include:

  • Define and evolve Alan's visual identity and brand systems, and make sure they hold up across every touchpoint.

  • Own briefs end-to-end: understand the business problem, help shape the strategy, then explore, prioritize, and ship the solution.

  • Create and art-direct campaigns and assets across the web, including our landing pages, email, advertising, and social channels, bringing the brand to life through art direction, motion, and video.

  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Brand to translate business objectives into visuals that convert.

  • Extend brand design work into our Health & Prevention area, alongside our core Marketing & Brand responsibilities.

  • Scale production to deliver high volumes of assets without losing quality or brand consistency.

  • Leadership & mentoring:
    - You lead through influence by shaping roadmaps, aligning stakeholders around well-reasoned proposals and trade-offs, and proactively communicating progress and plans.
    - You raise the bar for others by coaching and mentoring designers and non-designers, and helping Alaners grow through thoughtful feedback and technical or creative leadership.

Our current Design priorities 🌟

Our Design community red thread is to grow our brand design practice and ensure consistency in order to build an established and memorable brand.

To succeed in this mission, we currently:

  • Consolidating and scaling our visual identity across every touchpoint: web, email, ads, social, and increasingly our own landing pages, where brand expression and conversion design meet.

  • Growing our motion and video capability: it's a big plus for this role, not a nice-to-have.

  • Creating impactful physical and event experiences that bring the brand to life beyond screens.

  • You are at the cutting edge of AI-enabled design and creative workflows, actively experimenting with emerging models and tools and turning them into practical ways to improve the quality, speed, and impact of your work.

  • Extending brand identity into our Health & Prevention area, alongside our core Marketing & Brand responsibilities.

  • Shaping how Alan's mascot and visual universe show up, used deliberately, not everywhere.

If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit 👯‍♀️

  • 4+ years' experience, ideally in a product company or startup, we're hiring at a Senior level.

  • You are fluent in English.

  • You are an experienced user of design software (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma) and motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere is a plus).

  • Comfortable with generative AI tools, and keen to experiment with new approaches as you push creative boundaries within brand guidelines.

  • A deep understanding of growth, campaigns, and conversion-focused design, with a strong sense of how visuals drive business outcomes.

  • Able to scale and deliver high volumes of assets while keeping quality and brand consistency intact.

  • Understands business objectives and audiences, and can turn a brief into impactful visuals autonomously.

  • Experienced designing for online platforms: websites, social media, email marketing, and display ads.

  • You excel at communicating and articulating creative choices in a compelling way.

  • You're structured, and understand that goals and constraints need to be clarified before executing.

  • A portfolio showing real product/company work (not just agency spec work), illustration capability, and range across formats.

  • Based in (or open to relocating to) Paris (preferred), or Marseille, Bordeaux, Madrid, Brussels, or Barcelona.

Nice to have:

  • You are familiar with concepts like target audience, branding, user experience (UX), and conversion optimization.

  • You possess great 3D skills

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D+ level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Communications Lead
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Yubo doesn't have a PR team yet, and that's exactly why this role exists: to build one from scratch and help Yubo become culturally relevant, resilient to reputational bumps, and a real driver of growth.

It's a rare chance to shape a PR function from day one inside a fast-moving global tech company. You'll design how it works, lead our agency partner, and craft the stories, moments and relationships that make people pay attention to Yubo. The role covers everyday consumer stories, corporate communications, and handling sensitive issues or crises when they arise. To start, you'll focus on the US, UK and France, with room to grow from there.

You'll report to the Director of Brand & Communications and work closely with teams across the business, especially Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal. You'll own the relationship with our PR agency, making sure they feel like a true extension of the team, and you'll help set up the habits and processes that make PR part of how Yubo works day to day.

This is a freelance role on a 6-month contract, with a target start in Q4 2026.

Your responsibilites

Set up how PR works at Yubo

  • Build PR operations and onboard Yubo's PR agency, setting clear ways to spot stories, check facts, and turn insight into coverage.

  • Dig into Yubo's data to find trends and stories worth telling.

  • Build a simple way to report on PR performance, linking coverage and sentiment to awareness and growth.

  • Review and embed Yubo's Crisis Comms Playbook.

Plan and run the PR agenda

  • Build Yubo's 2027 PR calendar and strategy, balancing campaigns, cultural moments, and day-to-day press activity.

  • Lead proactive and reactive media relations so Yubo speaks with a clear, consistent voice.

  • Spot and activate cultural moments through PR, research, events, creator partnerships and other earned activity.

  • Team up with Product and Data to build proof points and stories that show what Yubo means to people.

Look after Yubo's reputation

  • Advise senior leaders on reputational opportunities and risks.

  • Support corporate communications and reactive issues management when needed.

  • Work with Trust & Safety and Legal so Yubo talks about sensitive topics responsibly.

  • Help rally the right people internally when a crisis hits.

Who you are

You're a proactive PR lead with sharp cultural instincts and a track record of creating stories that genuinely earn attention, not just promote launches.

You'll bring:

  • Solid PR experience, with real results to show from leading a function or campaign.

  • A good read on Gen-Z culture and how 18 to 24 year-olds socialise and engage online.

  • Experience turning insight and data into media stories, including digging into data yourself to find the angle.

  • A track record of using different levers to earn attention: influencers, experts, events, activations, research, stunts.

  • Experience managing and getting the best out of an external PR agency.

  • Good judgement under pressure, with experience in issues or crisis communications.

  • Strong writing and speaking skills, comfortable with both consumer storytelling and sensitive corporate messaging.

  • The ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

  • A self-starter mindset, with examples of building something from the ground up.

Nice to have, but don't let that stop you:

  • Experience in high-growth tech, consumer apps, youth culture, media, entertainment or lifestyle.

  • Experience in the US market, including relationships with US media and journalists.

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, mission and community, and where our communications and reputation stand today.

  • Meet key people across Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal.

  • Start onboarding our PR agency and reviewing the Crisis Comms Playbook.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Have set up solid working habits with the PR agency and cross-functional teams.

  • Be well into building the 2027 PR strategy, calendar and measurement framework.

  • Have embedded the Crisis Comms Playbook and be actively building relationships with consumer, culture, lifestyle, tech and business media.

Within 6 months, you will

  • Have delivered Yubo's finished 2027 PR strategy and calendar.

  • Have landed our first standout data- and culture-led stories in top-tier media, backed by a working way to measure PR performance.

  • Have wrapped up the agency onboarding and defined the role of creators, experts, events and activations in Yubo's communications, leaving a solid foundation for what's next.

The recruitment process

  • A first introductory call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • A case study with Alex, our Brand Director.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

title: Validation Technician
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

As a Drone System Validation Technician & Remote Pilot, you will be a vital pillar of our flight operations. You will ensure that our fleet of autonomous drones remains operational, up to date, and ready for deployment at all times. Fleet Maintenance

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on the drone fleet.

  • Carry out repairs, upgrades, and component replacements.

  • Execute soldering, wiring, and mechanical assembly operations.

Flight Operations

  • Piloting drones during test campaigns.

  • Serve as the safety operator during test flights.

Logistics

  • Manage inventory for spare parts, batteries, and field equipment.

  • Organize transport and gear preparation for field testing campaigns.

Test Execution

  • Run standardized test protocols and checklists.

  • Report results and anomalies to the engineering teams.

Lab Management

  • Keep the workshop and validation lab clean, organized, and secure.

  • Ensure all necessary tools, consumables, and equipment are available and ready to use.

Candidate Profile

  • Technical degree or significant practical experience in electronics, mechanics, or RC modeling.

  • Strong manual dexterity: proficient in soldering, wiring, and mechanical assembly.

  • Rigorous, organized, and safety-conscious mindset.

  • Experience piloting multirotor or fixed-wing drones (remote pilot certification is a plus).

  • Strong interest in hands-on DIY / technical building projects.

  • English language proficiency: A2 level minimum.

  • Willingness to travel for field testing operations.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Global Events Lead
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

<aside>
🎯

"You just build a f\*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

</aside>

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

In a nutshell

Your impact

title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
Overview

getpress entwickelt eine eigene KI-Agenten-Plattform (LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Next.js) für die PR-Branche


Der Servicemarkt, von Legal über Consulting bis hin zu Agenturen, steht vor der größten Transformation der Geschichte. Gleichzeitig wird der milliardenschwere PR-Markt im Zeitalter von AI-Visibility gerade immer wichtiger. getpress, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden PR-Agenturen Deutschlands (>40 Leute, Kund*innen wie Trivago, Komoot, Fonio AI oder AutoScout24), hat sich entschieden, diesen Wandel zu führen statt abzuwarten. Wir bauen die PR Company der Zukunft: keine reine Service-Company mehr, sondern eine Service-as-a-Software-Company. 


Unser AI-Team besteht nun seit 4 Monaten, aktuell ein Developer, eine Produktmanagerin und unsere Head of AI. Die Grundarchitektur steht, erste Teile unserer PR-Plattform und des Multi-Agent-Systems laufen produktiv. Jetzt fehlst du – die Person, die als Backend Engineer das technische Fundament zusammen mit unserem zweiten Developer ownt und gemeinsam neu definiert, wie die PR der Zukunft funktioniert.


Deine Rolle

  • PR-Plattform: Fullstack-Entwicklung der Plattform, die das Operating System der PR-Agentur 2027 wird. Nah an den Nutzer*innen, in schnellen Entwicklungszyklen, und wo deine Entscheidungen den Kurs setzen.

  • KI-Agenten: Aufbau eines Agenten-Systems, das die PR-Wertschöpfungskette End-to-End neu definiert. Du baust die Agenten, mit denen unsere Berater*innen täglich arbeiten, inkl. Self-Learning-Loops und Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung.

  • Systemarchitektur: Mitgestalten der Systemarchitektur, inkl. Workflows, Datenmodell, Schnittstellen, Compliance und Tech Stack (bisher vorwiegend PostgreSQL, Next.js, LangGraph, Docker)

  • Datenmanagement: Weiterentwicklung der Datenbank-Architektur inkl. relationaler Daten- und Vektor-Datenbanken


Wer du bist

Must haves:

  • > 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung

  • > 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten und -Komponenten wie Memory, Context-Engineering, Retrieval und Orchestration unter Verwendung von Frameworks wie Langchain, CrewAI, Langgraph o.ä.

  • Tech Stack: TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, LangGraph, Github

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Systemen mit Frameworks (fastAPI, springboot, nestJS, etc.) und gängigen Programmiersprachen (z.B. Java, Typescript, Python)

  • Erfahrung mit Container-based und Cloud-native Architekturen (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS oder ähnlich)

  • C1-Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, B2-Niveau ist ausreichend (mit Motivation in deinem ersten Arbeitsjahr den Kurs zu C1 zu machen)

Nice to haves:

  • Datenkompetenz: Sicher in SQL, API Design, Schema-Design, Query Optimization

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI-/ML-Modellen in Produktionssysteme, sowie im Verständnis des Modellverhaltens, der Modellleistung und der Modellbeschränkungen

  • Product-Engineering: Erfahrung darin, Anforderungen aus Business- und Nutzer:innen-Perspektive einzuordnen, bevor sie technisch umgesetzt werden

  • Erfahrung in Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, o.ä.)

  • Erfahrung mit Agentic Development (Claude Code, Codex, o.ä.)


Was dich erwartet

  • Architekt des Tech-Layers: Du bist unser technischer Experte und gestaltest mit, wie getpress Technologie denkt und nutzt

  • KI in Anwendung: Du bringst KI an der Vorfront technischer Möglichkeiten in unsere Prozesse und Strategie

  • Autonomie: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Management, setzt eigene Ideen um und definierst Standards, an denen wir uns orientieren

  • Ein echtes Team: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge.

  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob im Berliner Office oder remote (in DE) – wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wir suchen jemanden mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Das heißt wann und wo (in DE) du deinen Arbeitsalltag gestaltest, entscheidest du selbst. Klare Kommunikation und Vertrauen sind dabei für uns selbstverständlich.


Wie gehts weiter?

Das klingt genau nach dir?

Dann sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

description:

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Role: Senior Support Specialist (Enterprise Agentic AI)

Company: Ema Unlimited Inc.
Location: London
Employment Type: Full-time/Remote

 
 

1. About Ema (Why Ema)

Ema is building the world’s first Universal AI Employee — a production-grade agentic AI platform that automates real enterprise workflows across HR, IT, Finance, and Operations.

Ema’s customers do not run demos. They replace mission-critical, manual business processes with agentic AI systems that operate across multiple SaaS tools, APIs, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

In this world, support is not reactive. Support is production reliability, trust preservation, and system learning. At Ema, Senior Technical Support Specialists are operators of live AI systems, not ticket handlers.

 

2. Role Overview

The Senior Support Engineer owns the health, reliability, and trustworthiness of Ema’s deployed agentic AI systems in production. This role sits at the intersection of:

  • AI behavior

  • Workflow orchestration

  • Enterprise integrations

  • Customer trust

  • Engineering feedback loops

This is: ❌ Not L1 / call-center support, ❌ Not a “just escalate to engineering” role, ❌ Not reactive firefighting only

This is: A senior technical escalation role, A production debugging and RCA role, A partner to Engineering, Product, and Implementation, A role with real authority during incidents

3. Impact of the Role

Impact at Ema

  • You are the last line of defense between a production issue and customer trust erosion

  • You prevent small failures from turning into account-level crises

  • You ensure learnings from incidents improve the product and delivery systemically

Impact on Customers

  • Customers trust Ema because issues are handled competently and transparently

  • AI failures are explained, mitigated, and prevented — not hand-waved

  • Production stability improves over time, not degrades

Impact on Your Career

  • You gain rare experience operating agentic AI systems in production

  • You build deep expertise across AI, integrations, and workflows

  • You can grow into Reliability Engineering, Implementation Leadership, or Product-facing roles

4. Core Problems You Will Solve

  • Diagnosing failures in multi-agent AI workflows

  • Deeply understanding Ema’s platform and providing workarounds/alternate approaches to customers facing issues

  • Debugging issues spanning:

    • AI behavior (false positives / negatives)

    • Workflow logic

    • Integrations (HRIS, ITSM, IAM, Finance)

    • Data quality

    • Platform configuration

  • Handling Sev-1 / Sev-2 customer specific incidents calmly under customer pressure

  • Help Engineering & Product teams Prevent repeated incidents through disciplined RCA

  • Converting noisy customer complaints into high-signal engineering feedback

 

5. Jobs To Be Done

5.1 Production Issue Ownership

  • Own customer-reported issues from intake to resolution adhering strictly to SLAs

  • Take responsibility for diagnosis, coordination, and closure; Importantly, provide workarounds to customers to unblock them while engineering fix is made

  • Ensure no issue is “lost” between teams

  • Act as technical owner even when multiple teams are involved

 

5.2 Debugging, Diagnosis & Sev 1/2 Issue Resolution

  • Debug agentic workflows end-to-end

  • Trace failures across agents, tools, integrations, and humans-in-the-loop

  • Identify whether issues are caused by:

    • Model behavior

    • Prompt / policy logic

    • Workflow orchestration

    • Integration constraints

    • Customer configuration

  • Provide clear, actionable root cause summaries

  • Resolve Sev 1 / Sev 2 Client issues; Escalate to the right team to help solve and close the issue. Keep customer communication calm, factual, and confidence-building

 

5.4 Customer Communication & Trust

  • Communicate during incidents without speculation or panic

  • Explain AI failures in a way customers can understand

  • Set realistic recovery timelines

  • Rebuild trust post-incident through transparency and follow-through

5.6 Feedback Loops to Engineering & Product

  • Write high-signal bug reports and incident summaries

  • Advocate for fixes based on customer impact, not noise

  • Help Product understand real production behavior

  • Ensure support insights influence roadmap and quality improvement

 

5.7 Support Operations & Excellence

  • Improve runbooks, playbooks, and diagnostics

  • Improve on-call hygiene and escalation clarity

  • Mentor junior support engineers

  • Raise the overall support bar at Ema

 

6. Traits We’re Looking For

Technical & Diagnostic Strength

  • Excellent debugging instincts

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous systems

  • Able to isolate root cause across layers

Ownership & Reliability Mindset

  • Issues do not bounce — they get owned

  • Calm during incidents

  • Bias toward permanent fixes

Judgment & Communication

  • Knows when to escalate and when not to

  • Can say “we don’t know yet” credibly

  • Communicates clearly with both engineers and customers

Cultural Fit

  • Low ego, high accountability

  • Truth-seeking over blame

  • Respects both customer urgency and engineering quality

 
 

7. Required Qualifications

  • 6–9+ years in senior technical support, reliability, or production engineering roles

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms in production

  • Strong understanding of:

    • APIs and integrations

    • Distributed systems

    • Logs, traces, and diagnostics

  • Experience handling escalations and incidents

  • Customer-facing experience with senior stakeholders

8. Preferred Background

  • Support or reliability roles in AI / automation platforms

  • Experience with workflow orchestration or agentic systems

  • Familiarity with AWS / GCP / Azure

  • Background in high-availability, 24×7 systems

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Your mission

As Engineering Manager at Cosuno, you will lead a team of full stack engineers while staying deeply hands-on: you'll spend 60–80% of your time coding, reviewing, and shaping the architecture alongside your team. You are the kind of leader who elevates a team by example — writing code that sets the bar, and building an environment where great engineers do their best work.

Your mission might include:

  • Leading a team of full stack and AI/ML engineers: coaching, regular 1:1s, growth plans, and hiring — while shipping product yourself every week.

  • Owning the delivery and technical quality of your team's roadmap, working closely with your Product Manager to plan, de-risk, and execute.

  • Contributing hands-on across our TypeScript stack (React + Node), from designing features to reviewing pull requests and tackling the hard problems yourself.

  • Raising the team's technical bar through code reviews, architectural guidance, and best practices — including driving the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Partnering with engineering leadership on team topology, processes, and the technical direction of our platform.

How We Build: Our Engineering Culture

We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:

  • Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.

  • Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.

  • DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.

  • Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.

Your profile

We're looking for a player-coach: a strong engineer who leads people without giving up the keyboard. You'll be a great fit if you have:

  • Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) in software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable web applications.

  • Strong expertise in our core technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React) and the ability to reason about the entire stack, from the database to the browser — and you still use it daily.

  • Leadership experience — whether as an Engineering Manager or team lead with direct reports, or as a senior tech lead who has mentored engineers, led projects, and shaped how a team works.

  • A genuine desire to keep coding: this role is 60–80% hands-on by design, and that's what excites you about it.

  • A passion for growing people. You find joy in helping other engineers develop, in giving honest feedback, and in building a healthy, high-performing team.

  • Bonus, not required: a good understanding of building LLM-based applications or ML algorithms — your team includes AI/ML engineers, and being able to follow their work helps, though you won't need to be the expert.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Why us

  • Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.

  • Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.

  • Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.

  • A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.

  • Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Why Cosuno?

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.
